title: What If Iran Tests a Nuke? Israel's 4-Day Answer
description:
What would happen if Iran tested a nuclear bomb and Israel answered? This is a day-by-day simulation, built from published models and real history, of how one underground test could lead to a 10-kiloton Israeli strike on a buried mountain site eight minutes after launch.

This film follows the first 96 hours after the test, with the engine's blast numbers for one warhead and the one question nobody can answer: did it reach what was buried inside?

Four thirty-eight in the morning, central Iran: a nuclear warhead bursts on a mountain. Eight minutes earlier, a Jericho missile left a battery in central Israel. Four days before, that mountain hosted Iran's first nuclear test.

This is a simulation. It has not happened. It is not a forecast and uses no real date. The 2025 strikes on Fordow and Natanz, the enrichment figures and the war games are real; scenario segments are labelled SIMULATION on screen, facts REAL DATA or REAL HISTORY.

How this video was made: the narration is AI-generated (Google Text-to-Speech). Scenario segments are simulations built from published models and open sources; the test site, the timeline, the weapon and the 10-kiloton yield are ours, a scenario, not a forecast.
Maps: Natural Earth (public domain), OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) via OpenFreeMap and OpenMapTiles. Imagery: NASA Blue Marble and Black Marble. Music: generated with Eleven Music.
